monsters.1: A Guardian created to be Wyveria's savior. It was feeding off the Dragontorch, drawing from the vast stores of energy while it slumbered.
monsters.2: An artificial species created by an ancient civilization with a Doshaguma's power. They boast an incredibly robust physique and can spew acid.
monsters.3: The flying wyvern that reigns supreme over the Windward Plains' ecosystem. It is able to store, amplify, and discharge the Sandtide's lightning.
monsters.4: Temnocerans native to the Scarlet Forest with distinctive, pirouette-like movements. The florets they release have a paralytic effect.
monsters.5: Large, pink fanged beasts. Beware their potent breath, which changes based on their mushroom diet, and stench, which disables recovery items.
monsters.6: Temnocerans that afflict poison, sleep, and webbing ailments—skillfully cornering prey, then hunting it with their pincer-like jaws.
monsters.7: Monsters draped in great wings like a black overcoat. They have no eyes, so instead they use a scattering of fine scales to locate prey.
monsters.8: Large wyverns found in the Oilwell Basin. Their highly developed carapaces repel attacks and emit powerful heat rays.
monsters.9: An artificial species created by an ancient civilization based on a presumed extinct, legendary monster called Arkveld.
monsters.10: Brute wyverns that spread flammable vapor which they then ignite with their tails. They subsist on prey stolen from other predators.
monsters.11: Rugged, territorial fanged beasts that exhibit an aggressive disposition and inhabit a large range. Sometimes observed in large packs.
monsters.12: Desert-dwelling leviathans that use their supple, serpentine bodies to create quicksand traps. Weak against sonic bombs when they're submerged.
monsters.13: The "Queen of the Land," these female fire-breathing wyverns are known for their powerful legs and lethal, poison-secreting tails.
monsters.14: Amphibians that affix rocks to their forelimbs to power up attacks. Break this "armor" to create an attack opening. The tongue is most vulnerable.
monsters.15: Specially evolved leviathans, Mizutsune can secrete a peculiar foam that deftly covers their foes in dangerous bubbles.
monsters.16: An artificial species created by an ancient civilization with a Fulgur Anjanath's power. They can discharge lightning and have a nasty bite.
monsters.17: Leviathans that inhabit the Iceshard Cliffs. They have sharp, pincer-like tails and membranes on their necks that catch the wind to keep them aloft.
monsters.18: Bird wyverns with impressive beaks, big ears, and an appetite for insects. Skittish by nature, they will still put up a fight if threatened.
monsters.19: Dappled brute wyverns that prowl Oilwell Basin. The gas from their tongues is toxic, and the gas in their tails can detonate the earth.
monsters.20: A wyvern with chain-like wings. The flexible chainblades on their wings are used to mow down prey and absorb elemental energy.
monsters.21: Fanged beasts that adhere metal to their bodies and use friction to heat and cause explosions. They move in groups during the Firespring.
monsters.22: Monsters that use their prominent crest to stun foes with disorienting flashes of light before finishing them off with poisonous saliva.
monsters.23: Cephalopods that roam the Ruins of Wyveria and prey on Guardians. This often leads to conflicts between the two monsters.
monsters.24: An artificial species created by an ancient civilization with a Rathalos's power. Beware the energy released by their powerful claw attacks.
monsters.25: The leviathan that reigns supreme over the Scarlet Forest's ecosystem. Its protective veil can also generate a wave to keep foes at bay.
monsters.26: A leviathan that sits at the peak of the Iceshard Cliffs' ecosystem. It generates cold air via cooling organs across its massive body.
monsters.27: The cephalopod that reigns supreme over Oilwell Basin's ecosystem. A vision of hell, it attacks with tentacles and ignited oilsilt.
monsters.28: An artificial species created by an ancient civilization with an Ebony Odogaron's power. The flurries from their foreclaws pose a threat.
monsters.29: Fearsome wyverns known as "Kings of the Skies." Armed with powerful poison claws, they use their aerial prowess to descend on prey from above.
monsters.30: Large, white fanged beasts that rule over other Blango, attacking as a pack. They exhibit a range of mobility, particularly in snowy climes.
monsters.31: Leviathans that exist at the top of the aquatic food chain. They have appeared in the waters of the Scarlet Forest, drawn in by its fertile environment.
monsters.32: Fiercely territorial flying wyverns known for the sharp, blade-like scales covering their bodies.
monsters.33: An Omega frame that crossed the interdimensional rift. It descended on the Forbidden Lands to find stronger lifeforms and planets to invade.
monsters.34: A mysterious elder dragon covered head to tail in a viscous black liquid that was found hibernating in an expanse beneath Azuz.
